import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Map 'is_fraud' for better readability in plots
# Define the order for consistent legend/color mapping
fraud_status_order = ['Not Fraud', 'Fraud']
df['is_fraud_label'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Not Fraud', 1: 'Fraud'})

# Set up the matplotlib figure and axes for three subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(12, 18))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Analysis Overview', fontsize=18, y=1.02) # Overall title for the figure

# Define a distinct palette for fraud status categories
# Paired palette is good for two categorical variables
fraud_palette = {
    'Not Fraud': sns.color_palette("Paired")[0],  # A shade of blue
    'Fraud': sns.color_palette("Paired")[1]       # A shade of orange/red
}

# --- Plot 1: Distribution of Transaction Amount by Fraud Status ---
sns.histplot(data=df, x='amount', hue='is_fraud_label', hue_order=fraud_status_order,
             kde=True, stat='density', common_norm=False, ax=axes[0], palette=fraud_palette,
             alpha=0.7, linewidth=0) # alpha for transparency, linewidth=0 for cleaner kde
axes[0].set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amount by Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
axes[0].legend(title='Fraud Status', title_fontsize='12', fontsize='10')

# --- Plot 2: Transaction Count by Type and Fraud Status ---
sns.countplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud_label', hue_order=fraud_status_order,
              ax=axes[1], palette=fraud_palette)
axes[1].set_title('Transaction Count by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
axes[1].legend(title='Fraud Status', title_fontsize='12', fontsize='10')
axes[1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15) # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability if categories are long

# --- Plot 3: Transaction Count by Hour of Day and Fraud Status ---
# Sort hours for better visual order on the x-axis
df_sorted_hour = df.sort_values('hour_of_day')
sns.countplot(data=df_sorted_hour, x='hour_of_day', hue='is_fraud_label', hue_order=fraud_status_order,
              ax=axes[2], palette=fraud_palette)
axes[2].set_title('Transaction Count by Hour of Day and Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[2].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[2].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
axes[2].legend(title='Fraud Status', title_fontsize='12', fontsize='10')
axes[2].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2)) # Set x-ticks to show every 2 hours for clarity

# Adjust layout to prevent labels/titles from overlapping
plt.tight_layout()
fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.94) # Adjust subplots to make space for the overall super title

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
